basic_details.job_title: MLSU Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 2 Project Associate, Project Assistant Posts
basic_details.short_information: The UGC Centre for Women's Studies, University College of Social Sciences & Humanities, Mohanlal Sukhadia University, Udaipur, has invited applications for two temporary, project-based posts for the period November 2026 to March 2027: Project Associate (Academic) at Rs. 30,000 per month and Project Assistant (Non-Academic) at Rs. 20,000 per month, both consolidated pay. Applications go on plain paper to the Centre or by email to [email protected] by 13.11.2026 before 05:00 PM, and the interview is on 16.11.2026.

how_to_apply: Prepare a complete application on plain paper with a cover letter and a complete CV.
Attach attested copies of certificates and mark sheets and a passport-size photograph.
Send the application to UGC Centre for Women's Studies, UCSSH, MLSU, or mail it to [email protected].
Make sure it is sent by 13.11.2026 before 05:00 PM. Incomplete applications will not be considered.
Shortlisted candidates will be informed by email and called for an interview.
The notice prints no full postal address for submission beyond the Centre's name; the letterhead gives the Centre's address as Udaipur, Rajasthan 313001.
Attested copies of certificates and mark sheets
At the time of joining: all original certificates for verification, with one set of photocopies
important_instructions: Incomplete applications will not be considered. The selected candidate will have to join duty immediately on receipt of the offer. The appointed person will have no claim of appointment in the funding agency or in Mohanlal Sukhadia University. No interim enquiries, correspondence or communication of any sort will be entertained on the matter. The sanction is for the stated period only and depends on the UGC extending the scheme; appointments end automatically if the scheme is not extended or funding is withdrawn.

content_sections.heading: About MLSU Centre for Women's Studies
content_sections.text: The UGC Centre for Women's Studies is part of the University College of Social Sciences & Humanities at Mohanlal Sukhadia University, Udaipur, Rajasthan. The two posts are temporary and project-based, sanctioned under the Women's Studies Centre scheme for the period November 2026 to March 2027 only. The notice states that appointments end automatically if the scheme is not extended or funding is withdrawn.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice advertises one post each, 2 posts in total. It prints no category-wise break-up.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: For both posts, the prescribed qualification should have been obtained from UGC recognised universities/institutions. The notice does not print an age limit. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

rows.essential_qualification: Master's degree (MA) in Women's Studies, Sociology, or a related social science discipline with at least 55% marks or equivalent grade
rows.preference: NET/SET, M.Phil., or Ph.D. in a relevant discipline, and experience in gender studies research

rows.essential_qualification: Graduate or Master's degree in any discipline, with computer proficiency (MS Office, typing, and data entry)
rows.preference: Experience in office or project administration

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Both posts carry consolidated pay: Rs. 30,000/- per month for the Project Associate and Rs. 20,000/- per month for the Project Assistant. The notice names no allowances. The positions run for November 2026 to March 2027, subject to the UGC extending the Women's Studies Centre scheme for the next year. The appointment is purely temporary and terminates automatically, without notice, on termination of the project or scheme.

content_sections.heading: MLSU Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Research support Data collection and analysis Report writing Academic coordination of the Centre's activities Office and administrative support Documentation Maintaining records and accounts Assisting the Project Associate and Centre Faculty

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for MLSU Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Prepare a complete application on plain paper with a cover letter and a complete CV. Attach attested copies of certificates and mark sheets and a passport-size photograph. Send the application to UGC Centre for Women's Studies, UCSSH, MLSU, or mail it to [email protected] . Make sure it is sent by 13.11.2026 before 05:00 PM. Incomplete applications will not be considered. Shortlisted candidates will be informed by email and called for an interview. The notice prints no full postal address for submission beyond the Centre's name; the letterhead gives the Centre's address as Udaipur, Rajasthan 313001. Cover letter and complete CV Attested copies of certificates and mark sheets Passport-size photograph At the time of joining: all original certificates for verification, with one set of photocopies

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection is by shortlisting based on qualifications and experience, followed by an interview. The notice also states that selection is based on the recommendation made by the committee. Shortlisted candidates will be informed by email. The interview will be conducted at the UGC Centre for Women's Studies, MLSU, on 16.11.2026. The notice prints no interview time.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Incomplete applications will not be considered. The selected candidate will have to join duty immediately on receipt of the offer. The appointed person will have no claim of appointment in the funding agency or in Mohanlal Sukhadia University. No interim enquiries, correspondence or communication of any sort will be entertained on the matter. The sanction is for the stated period only and depends on the UGC extending the scheme; appointments end automatically if the scheme is not extended or funding is withdrawn.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in MLSU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 posts: 1 Project Associate (Academic) and 1 Project Assistant (Non-Academic).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date is 13.11.2026, before 05:00 PM. Incomplete applications will not be considered.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Project Associate?
faq.answer: A Master's degree (MA) in Women's Studies, Sociology or a related social science discipline with at least 55% marks or equivalent grade. NET/SET, M.Phil. or Ph.D. in a relevant discipline and gender studies research experience are preferred.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Project Assistant?
faq.answer: A Graduate or Master's degree in any discipline, with computer proficiency (MS Office, typing and data entry). Experience in office or project administration is preferred.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for these posts?
faq.answer: The Project Associate gets consolidated pay of Rs. 30,000/- per month and the Project Assistant Rs. 20,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply?
faq.answer: Send a plain-paper application with cover letter, CV, attested copies of certificates and mark sheets, and a passport-size photograph to UGC Centre for Women's Studies, UCSSH, MLSU, or mail it to [email protected].

faq.question: Q7. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Selection is by shortlisting based on qualifications and experience, followed by an interview. Selection is based on the committee's recommendation.

faq.question: Q8. When is the interview?
faq.answer: The interview is on 16.11.2026 at the UGC Centre for Women's Studies, MLSU. Shortlisted candidates will be informed by email.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The posts are temporary and project-based for November 2026 to March 2027, and end automatically if the UGC does not extend the scheme or funding is withdrawn.

faq.question: Q10. What must I bring when joining?
faq.answer: Bring all original certificates for verification, along with one set of photocopies.
